• Human review for ambiguity and risk
• MCP separates agent reasoning from external integrations
• AgentCore Runtime provides managed agent execution
• AgentCore Gateway provides centralized MCP access
• DynamoDB supports idempotency and application state
• Least-privilege IAM
• Observable and auditable agent execution
• Serverless / managed AWS services where practical
